brief: The owner's answers to D-089's questions.
entry: Web address: the owner defers to the product owner, whose D-089 position stands: Octave Web at /, with /web/ passing the Quick Connect address to it and still serving an operator's build. Jellyfin Desktop and webOS: decided later, by the product owner, on JS-150's observation of them. jellyfin-web stays the compatibility check while Octave Web is being built. The image ships no default web client for now. The language settings page (JS-122) is broadly compatible with jellyfin-web and puts Octave Web users first. The owner defers most such questions to the product owner. PRODUCT.md's wording is not yet approved.
